title: The board’s role in managing emerging AI risks
description: Leading cybersecurity executives and board directors discuss the challenges and opportunities of AI.

title: How provider-led health plans can succeed in commercial insurance
description: Provider-led health plans are underrepresented in the commercial group insurance market, leaving more than $20 billion in potential revenue and $700 million in operating margin on the table.

title: Australian consumer loyalty: Rapid change calls for rapid solutions
description: Consumer expectations in Australia are changing; organisations can leverage their loyalty programmes to keep up with ongoing shifts.

title: Author Talks: Testing AI’s limits in a one-year experiment
description: What happens when AI runs your life for a year? NBC News Chief Technology Analyst Joanna Stern reveals surprising gains—and unsettling trade-offs—to embedding AI into everything from labor to leisure.

title: Europe on the move: A conversation with Hitachi Energy’s CEO
description: As the world enters what the IEA calls the “age of electricity,” Hitachi Energy is leading the evolution of the energy system for a fully electrified world—making electricity abundant and more accessible in Europe and worldwide.

title: Shifting into high gear: India’s auto component sector
description: Several intersecting trends are shaping and accelerating growth in India’s auto component sector, creating compelling opportunities for investors and industry players alike.

title: For 250 years, America didn’t just invent the future—it built it. That connection is breaking. Here’s how to restore it
description: For 250 years, America has done something no other country has managed at comparable scale: it has not merely invented the future, it has built it. Many of the foundations of modern life are distinctly American, write Eric Kutcher, Shubham Singhal, Olivia White, and Scott Blackburn in Fortune.

title: Boosting industrial and economic growth: Today’s Titanium Economy
description: Industrial sector growth and investor recognition have skyrocketed, powered by small- and mid-cap Titanium Economy companies. Learn why—and how to put their successful formula into action.

title: The AI assembly line: Strategic imperatives for CEOs
description: AI has proven its potential, but value remains hard to scale. To turn experimentation into sustained performance, CEOs must reimagine their organizations.

title: CARE for women: Investing in care delivery to improve women’s lives and livelihoods
description: Care delivery failures account for 34 percent of the women’s health gap. Earlier preventive care could avert tens of thousands of adverse events and generate three- to sixfold returns through lower medical costs.

title: Quantum’s breakthrough
description: Quantum is approaching an inflection point, bringing significant economic opportunity—and potential security risks. Are business leaders ready to harness quantum’s potential?

title: Japan’s $100 billion opportunity in general-purpose robotics
description: Can Japan translate its hardware expertise into AI, data, and software to emerge as a leader as general-purpose robots scale?

title: Primary care, reimagined: Workforce and care model innovation in a modern age
description: Inequitable access to primary care jeopardizes the health of millions of Americans, especially in rural communities, resulting in the equivalent of 45 million people with unmet primary care needs.

title: For industrials, the next decade belongs to builders
description: As core growth stalls, a small set of AI-enabled business-building plays is emerging as the fastest path to new revenue for industrial and energy leaders that know how to execute successfully.

title: A hidden figure behind GPS, a cycling champion, and a quiet trucking giant
description: Our latest obituaries also include a Hollywood animator, a cable industry innovator, and a prize-winning doctor who built a tuberculosis lab.

title: Five steps to turning geopolitical volatility into an advantage
description: As geopolitics redraws trade flows and strategic priorities, CEOs who anticipate the shifts—and reallocate capital accordingly—can create durable new growth pathways.

title: The surprising economics of B2B growth: The new survival threshold—and what it takes to thrive
description: The 2026 Global B2B Pulse Survey finds a divide between leaders and laggards—and shows how integrating hyperpersonalization, AI, and sales accountability creates a new operating system for growth.

title: Move first or fall behind: How AI is rewriting the rules of banking
description: AI is poised to reshape banking not just by cutting costs, but by redistributing profits, redefining customer relationships, and accelerating competition. How should banks respond?

title: Rewiring software delivery for the agentic era
description: The way agentic AI is being used in software development is a harbinger for broader changes in the delivery model.

title: Building the AI advantage: How ADEO is preparing for retail’s next wave
description: The global home-improvement retailer’s chief digital and information officer on unlocking the potential of AI—and keeping people’s feet on the ground.

title: An update on US consumer sentiment: Gloomier outlook ahead of sunnier days
description: Ahead of the summer season, a smaller share of US consumers reported optimism while a greater share reported cost concerns, which could impact their spending across discretionary categories. Here’s the latest research from our ConsumerWise team.

title: Beyond stablecoins: The emerging architecture of on-chain money
description: As attention focuses on stablecoins, a larger $4 trillion transformation is underway, integrating bank deposits and central bank assets into a unified global monetary stack.

title: The next era of healthcare is personal
description: Moderna CEO Stéphane Bancel explains how mRNA, AI, and individualized care could transform everything from vaccines to cancer treatment.

title: Wired for growth: India’s electrical-equipment opportunity
description: Amid a global surge in electrification, India’s scaling domestic demand and structural advantages could make it a globally competitive electrical-equipment-manufacturing powerhouse.

title: Global Banking Annual Review 2026: Precision with speed
description: In this preview of our 2026 Global Banking Annual Review, we provide a glimpse of banks’ continued strong results in 2025; the emergence of a new world map; the tipping point for customer ownership; and the unprecedented pace at which AI is remaking the industry, prompting banks to accelerate their precision strategies and evolve into multispeed organizations.

title: Ramping up manufacturing in America?
description: Probing how much manufacturing ramp-up would be needed to address US trade dependencies.

title: Alabama’s playbook for jobs, growth, and economic opportunity
description: Ellen McNair, the secretary of commerce for Alabama, discusses the state’s CatALyst economic development strategy and the value of strong partnerships in driving investment and inclusive growth.

title: Sell, close, or continue? The transfer of US businesses is at a crossroads
description: McKinsey research on small-business succession reveals trillions in opportunity—but significant gaps in financing, infrastructure, and postclose support for potential new owners.

title: What to tell graduates who ask you for advice right now
description: This time of year, many leaders find themselves in a familiar position. A child. A niece or nephew. A friend’s son or daughter. A new graduate reaching out for advice. The question sounds simple: “What advice do you have for me as I start my career?” But this year, it carries more weight than usual. Because the world they are entering is changing faster than the one we entered. And almost everyone can feel it, writes Kweilin Ellingrud in Forbes.

title: HackerOne CEO Kara Sprague on how AI is reshaping cybersecurity
description: HackerOne CEO Kara Sprague discusses how AI is reshaping the cybersecurity landscape and why security teams must shift from finding vulnerabilities to reducing exposure.

title: eHBCU: A first-of-its-kind HBCU online consortium to expand economic mobility through education
description: Delaware State University partnered with McKinsey to form a first-of-its-kind multiuniversity consortium to expand access to degrees, credentials, and career pathways for online learners nationwide.

title: The Next Wow Factor: A Conversation with Sidney Lu, Chairman and CEO, Foxconn Interconnect Technology (FIT)
description: Sidney Lu has spent four decades building things no one thought Taiwan could build. His rule: every three years, deliver something that genuinely surprises — or risk becoming history. He isn’t done yet.

title: Enhancing Swedish security through deterrence and prosperity
description: To capture the opportunity for deterrence and prosperity, Sweden must overcome a set of challenges. The outcome will depend on Sweden’s ability to align on priorities, mobilize across stakeholders, and execute with speed.

title: Advancing adaptation in Southeast Asia
description: The benefits of adaptation in Southeast Asia far outweigh its costs—yet a significant resilience gap remains. What will it take to protect the region’s people and assets today, and support future economic growth?

title: Renewables O&M reimagined: Boosting performance with AI and conventional levers
description: Operators with growing onshore wind and solar PV portfolios can unlock hidden value by using a mix of conventional techniques and AI to optimize their operations and maintenance strategies.

title: Why a US governor’s first few months shape the full term
description: Three McKinsey experts explain why advance planning, a willingness to learn, and a strong team often determine whether an administration builds momentum to realize its agenda or struggles to succeed.

title: AI is already rewiring the aftermarket and services
description: For industrial companies, applying AI to the aftermarket and services could provide a source for differentiation on top of cost and time savings and enhanced customer experiences.

title: When AI meets desire: Innovating human-centered luxury experiences in the agentic age
description: With luxury consumers rapidly embracing AI, the strategic question for merchants is no longer whether agents will mediate the journey, but who controls how brands are perceived.

title: Global Economics Intelligence executive summary, April 2026
description: Oil price increases impact production costs and household budgets, while growth loses momentum; nevertheless, the broader economy continues to expand, leaving interest rates in a holding pattern.

title: Leslie Davis on serving communities as both payer and provider
description: Leslie Davis, president and CEO of UPMC, discusses the organization’s “payvider” model and how its emphasis on innovation has helped UPMC deliver better, more affordable care.

title: Advancing climate adaptation in Asia: Protecting people, protecting growth
description: Asia’s diverse adaptation needs are large, requiring much of the global adaptation spend going forward. Yet, the challenge also opens a significant opportunity for the region.

title: From AI table stakes to AI advantage: Building competitive moats
description: When everyone has access to the same AI models, the winners are those who use them to build advantages that competitors can’t copy.

title: Why it’s even more important to consider restructuring before spin-offs
description: The market is always revealing new reasons for leaders to consider improving assets before spinning them off—but the principles for how to manage such transactions are enduring. Here are three of them.

title: Where AI is creating real value in real estate
description: Agentic AI is moving real estate beyond isolated tools toward full workflow transformation—unlocking new value, redefining roles, and reshaping how organizations operate.

description: Saris, an agentic workflow platform for banks and credit unions, has raised $28.8 million in Series A funding.
